items.title: PayPlus (Israel)
items.body: No connection built and none in progress. Built as a new connection on request; scope and timeline confirmed with Yuno's integrations team.

slides.bar: In every country you asked about, cards already have several live providers, so none of these gaps leaves a market without coverage.
slides.notes: Owner and usual timeline for new connection requests are not recorded in the data; ask the Partnerships/Integrations team before committing a PayPlus date.
